model: The review photo carousel previous and next buttons each kept a backdrop blur while the pointer was over the photo. Both blur layers are gone, so a hovered carousel no longer samples the photo for those buttons.

noise.rule: 120 is 2 layers times 60 frames per second while both buttons are visible. Buttons stay hidden until hover, so the cost was only on the hovered photo. Not a sampled compositor trace. Relative is unbounded because the after count is zero.
